criteria.text: Unsafe or malformed endpoints fail closed before a provider call; approved HTTPS and intentional local test configurations work; tests cover bypass cases and documentation describes the policy.
Record sanitized test evidence and the tested revision, and update relevant documentation.

findings.summary: Risk: the shared TrustedHostNames grammar now also rejects IP-literal entries in dokene.integration.whatsapp.graph.additional-trusted-hosts, a backward-incompatible startup change for a Graph deployment that listed an IP; documented in ADR 0016 and invariant 29 but not called out as an upgrade note.
findings.evidence: backend/src/main/java/io/github/stevdrey/dokene/http/TrustedHostNames.java:12-19 (NUMERIC_LAST_LABEL); GraphApiProperties.java uses isExactHostName; GraphApiPropertiesTest adds 10.0.0.5, 169.254.169.254, 127.1 as rejected

findings.summary: Risk: exact loopback endpoints, cleartext http included, are accepted in every profile, not only test profiles; consistent with the documented policy (a loopback listener is local), but the 'explicitly controlled' test endpoint is controlled only by the base-url value itself.

checks.environment: local candidate worktree, Temurin 26.0.2, no Docker
checks.summary: OpenAiConfigurationTest 15, OpenAiEndpointPolicyTest 82, OpenAiResponsesApiAdapterTest 45, ModuleDependencyArchitectureTest 21, GraphApiPropertiesTest 43; 0 failures, 0 skipped. Includes 50 bypass cases, startup-failure-with-no-client-bean, shipped application.yml defaults, and the 307 redirect-not-followed test with an SDK-default control.

checks.command: exact disposable copy (git worktree add --detach + identity tree 5a28307 verified), add probes/H1/AdvParserDifferentialProbeTest.java, ./gradlew test --tests '*AdvParserDifferentialProbeTest' -i
checks.summary: probe: 25 tricky values (path @, //, %2F, dot segments, ;@, CRLF-encoded, port padding, case, IPv6 variants, punycode look-alike); every accepted value's canonical URL parses in OkHttp to an allowed host with no user info or query, plus the 'responses' segment appended; output in probes/H1/output.txt. Base control not-run: OpenAiEndpointPolicy does not exist on the base.

checks.command: same disposable copy with probes/H1/negative-control.patch (host allowlist removed: 'boolean trusted = https;'), ./gradlew test --tests '*AdvParserDifferentialProbeTest' -i
checks.summary: negative control: with the host allowlist removed the probe fails as intended on https://xn--pi-openai-xyz.com/v1 (25 tests, 1 failed), so C2 can detect an accepted foreign host; output in probes/H1/negative-control-output.txt.

checks.command: git diff f0b5062 HEAD -- docs .env.example backend/src/main/resources/application.yml compose.yaml
checks.summary: Reviewed: docs/verification/issue-322-openai-endpoint-validation-verification.md is sanitized (synthetic/loopback endpoints, no secrets), names tested revisions (2774f55 and its follow-up) and commands with results; ADR 0016 section, security invariant 29, audit L11 status, wiki, .env.example, application.yml and compose.yaml describe the policy and new variable consistently with the code.

limitations: Trigger rows hit: External integrations (OpenAiEndpointPolicy.java, OpenAiConfiguration.java, OpenAiProviderProperties.java; GraphApiProperties.java via TrustedHostNames.java). PII row judged not hit: the redacted toString and non-echoing error concern credentials/config values, not personal data.

Adversarial hypotheses: H1 URI-vs-OkHttp parser differential (probed, cleared, negatively controlled; base control not-run because the policy is new). H2 redirect re-sends body to unapproved host: covered by the candidate's own OpenAiConfigurationTest redirect test with its SDK-default control (passed in C1), but that test is added by the diff so it is not independent clearing; no separate probe. H3 an alternative client builder bypassing the policy: grep found only OpenAiConfiguration in main code (code reading, no probe). H4 Graph grammar change weakening Graph validation: GraphApiPropertiesTest diff only adds rejected cases and passes in C1. No pass finding raised; F1 and F2 are not restated.
The recorded broad './gradlew check' and spikeTest results in the verification record were not rerun (only filtered tests allowed); no live provider, no Compose run.
DNS resolution of trusted host names is not pinned (documented as out of scope).
